errors.text_span: Визуално се забелязва, че през 2024 г. индексите са най-високи в няколко месеца, като например март (над 120,000) и декември (над 125,000)
errors.evidence: The 2024 (gray) bar in March is around 125,000, and in December it is around 111,000, not above 125,000.

errors.text_span: докато през 2022 г. има значителен връх през юни (над 115,000) и декември (над 125,000)
errors.evidence: The 2022 (blue) bar in June is about 116,000, but the December bar is about 128,000, while June is not described accurately as a notable 'peak' relative to December; the text also implies both are simply over those thresholds without distinguishing the much higher December value.

errors.text_span: През 2023 г. стойностите са по-ниски в сравнение с другите две години, особено през март, август и декември.
errors.evidence: In March and August, 2023 is lower than the other years, but in December 2023 is lower than 2022 and 2024; this is broadly correct but phrased as a comparative interpretation rather than a direct visual description.
The description does not mention that the x-axis categories are Roman numerals I–XII, which is a visible stylistic/ordering feature of the grouped bars.
